sets.title: Grid puzzle 1: city and hobby of four people
sets.text:

1. Latha's city is Pune.
2. The person whose city is Kolkata has hobby painting.
3. Sneha's hobby is chess.
4. Kiran's hobby is not cycling.
5. The person whose city is Chennai has hobby cycling.
